summary:
Held 2 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — RI.PA +5%, MRO.L +5%, WPP.L +4%, DSFIR.AS +3%, SY1.DE +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 2 downside moves (LSEG.L -5%, BBY.L -4%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: RI.PA (+5.18%) — No confirmed company news. Pernod Ricard (RI.PA) rallied about 5% the day before its Q1 FY27 sales release on Oct 15, probably on pre-earnings positioning and a rebound in beaten-down spirits stocks. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: RI.PA is a Paris-listed large-cap consumer-staples (spirits) name that no strategy includes. With no company news, a news-reactive bot had no trigger, and a sector-wide rebound is not a signal it tracks.

top_movers.suggestion: Add a liquid-EU-large-cap tier (e.g. CAC 40/STOXX 50) to the momentum universe, with a pre-earnings-drift rule: allow entry when the gap is at least +3% and volume is at least 1.5× average, within 2 days of a scheduled results date.

top_movers.suggestion: Add FTSE 100 financial-data and exchange names (LSEG.L, etc.) to the mean-reversion universe. Gate entry on a 2-day stabilisation after M&A-driven gaps of -4% or more, instead of buying the initial drop.
